user.description:
ONLY E48HP/E48GP models supported!

Provide the same username/password as the KDK Ceiling Fan mobile app.

Ensure that you have already registered your fans in the app before connecting.

error.connection: Unable to connect to the server.

set_fan_and_light.name: Set fan and light
set_fan_and_light.description: Change a fan and its light together in one command: one round trip and one beep instead of two. Anything left out stays as it is.

fan_on.name: Fan on
fan_on.description: On turns the fan on at its last speed and direction; off turns it off. A fan speed, if given, is used instead of the last one.

light_on.name: Light on
light_on.description: On turns the light on exactly as it was last left: normal at its last brightness and colour, or night light at its last level. Off turns it off. A brightness or colour, if given, is used instead.

fan_percentage.name: Fan speed
fan_percentage.description: Fan speed in 10% steps, rounded up. 0 turns the fan off.

fan_direction.name: Fan direction
fan_direction.description: Forward or reverse. Keeps the current direction if left out.

light_brightness_pct.name: Light brightness
light_brightness_pct.description: Brightness in 10% steps, rounded up. 0 turns the light off; 10%, 20% and 30% are night light low, medium and high.

light_color_temp_kelvin.name: Light colour temperature
light_color_temp_kelvin.description: 3000 K (warm) to 7000 K (white). Not available with night light.
